Re: The Cape Breton Fiddlers’ Society’s Welcome To The Shetland Islands

The proper name of this tune is “The Cape Breton Symphony’s Welcome to the Shetland Islands”. The Cape Breton Symphony was a group of four fiddlers assembled for John Allan Cameron’s Canadian television show in the mid 1970s. The original members were Winston “Scotty” Fitzgerald, John Donald Cameron, Wilfred Gillis and Jerry Holland. Their leader and piano player was Bobby Brown, originally from Sterling, Scotland. The members changed over the years and they were active until the mid 1980s.

↳ Posted by Allie Bennett on August 6th, 2023.

Re: The Cape Breton Fiddlers’ Society’s Welcome To The Shetland Islands

Anvil Publishing’s Willie Hunter tunebook gives the original title simply as “The Cape Breton Visit to Shetland”, with 1982 as the date of composition. The recording to look out for is definitely the one where he segues seamlessly from the alternative high ending (in A) to “Peerie Willie” in B flat, starting two octaves below. A third Willie Hunter tune, “Lorna’s Reel”, in F, concludes the set.
